title: Huliheʻe Palace
geometryBasis: Named native palace outline, original coastal elevation, National Register measurements, Daughters of Hawaiʻi history and three exact published public-domain Qualla exterior photographs.
sectionBasis: A stuccoed two-story lava-rubble block with a low green metal gabled roof. A two-deck sea-facing timber lanai has finely spaced balusters, square posts, brackets and a long external stair at the end. Smaller porches mark the street and side entrances.
limitations: The original views establish the bayside lanai and side trim. Fine bracket shapes and details of the less visible landward entrance use architectural estimates.
The unchanged original relief is cropped to the palace grounds. The wider coastal DEM contains extreme values offshore.
